items.title: Synchronal Bimodal Nuclear Rocket Design for Deep Space Exploration
items.original_title: A New NASA Design Turbocharges Nuclear Spacecraft
items.summary: NASA and General Atomics engineers proposed the Synchronal Bimodal Nuclear Rocket (S-BNR), a dual-loop reactor design that combines high-thrust nuclear thermal propulsion with continuous nuclear electric power generation. By replacing complex mode-switching valves with separate high-temperature and low-temperature fuel zones within a single core, the architecture aims to reduce round-trip Mars transit times to under 335 days while simplifying life-support and cooling requirements.
bullets: The S-BNR uses an open fluid loop with high-temperature fuel elements (>2,700 K pebble beds) for hydrogen-based thermal propulsion and a closed loop with low-temperature fuel elements (≥1,200 K) for helium-xenon electrical power generation.
Eliminates high-risk mode-switching valves by physically separating the high-thrust and continuous-power fluid systems while allowing shared neutron criticality within a single reactor core.
Provides a thermal propulsion specific impulse over 900 seconds and electric propulsion efficiency up to 4,600 seconds, enabling fast orbital transfers and continuous onboard system power.

Solves post-burn cooling by transferring residual decay heat from high-temperature fuel elements to the low-temperature electrical generation loop, eliminating the need to expend extra liquid hydrogen.
Targeted engineering hurdles include managing neutron flux across wide power ranges, thermal balancing at fuel zone interfaces, and cost-effective ground testing with radioactive exhaust capture.

items.title: Why AI Needs Real-Time Web Data Infrastructure
items.original_title: Why Does AI Need Access to the Web?
items.summary: Pre-trained LLMs act as static knowledge snapshots, causing autonomous AI agents to fail rapidly and at scale when operating on outdated or missing context. To prevent hallucinations, AI architectures require a dedicated web data infrastructure layer that retrieves and processes live web content at inference time. This layer overcomes anti-bot barriers and transforms unstructured, token-heavy HTML into clean formats for LLMs.
bullets: Pre-trained model knowledge cutoffs cause Garbage In, Garbage Out (GIGO) errors that propagate and compound across multi-agent workflows.
Direct web scraping by LLMs often fails due to anti-bot protection, CAPTCHAs, and the severe token bloat of raw HTML.

Reliable web data infrastructure must fulfill five requirements: grounded (citations), deep (full documents over snippets), fresh (domain-appropriate refresh rates), formatted (clean Markdown/JSON), and timely (low latency).
Data freshness needs vary by volatility; e-commerce stock and pricing require inference-time updates, whereas technical specifications can be cached longer.
Formatting raw web pages into token-efficient Markdown or JSON prevents agent confusion caused by irrelevant CSS and JavaScript noise.

bullets: Nvidia acquired Hugging Face for $12.9B and secured a non-exclusive $6B license for Poolside's model factory to solidify its CUDA hardware ecosystem.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning for Robotics: Simulation to Real-World Deployment
items.original_title: Reinforcement Learning for Robotics: Simulation to Real-World Deployment (Mujoco + Gymnasium)
items.summary: This content outlines the end-to-end technical pipeline for implementing reinforcement learning controllers in robotics, moving iteratively between physics simulation, policy training, and hardware execution. It covers CAD integration into MuJoCo, Gymnasium environment construction using PPO, domain randomization techniques, and real-world considerations like unit conversion, safety e-stops, and ONNX model export.
bullets: Simulation modeling relies on exporting CAD geometry into STL files for MuJoCo MJCF/XML definitions, configuring hinge joints, positional/quaternion frame alignments, and motor parameters like damping, armature, and friction loss.

Policy training utilizes Gymnasium environment wrappers around MuJoCo to extract observation vectors (joint positions, IMU orientation, end-effector pose) and evaluate composite reward functions combining task bonuses with control effort penalties.

Robustness across the sim-to-real gap is achieved via programmatic domain randomization of link masses, damping coefficients, sensor latency, and torque scaling directly within the environment reset functions.
Training is executed via PPO policies using libraries like Stable-Baselines3, utilizing vectorized parallel environments and exporting neural network weights upon loss convergence.

Hardware deployment introduces an intermediate dummy environment for sensor calibration and action scaling, executing real-time control loops across protocols like CAN or SPI, while optionally exporting policies to ONNX for microcontroller inference.

items.title: Using Skill Files to Guide Agentic AI in Engineering Tasks
items.original_title: Engineering with Agentic AI: Using Skills to Improve Your Agent
items.summary: AI agents are proficient at coding due to public training data, but they lack domain-specific engineering best practices. By implementing markdown skill files, engineers can package workflows, design standards, and validation steps for agents to automatically reuse across sessions.
bullets: AI agents trained on public code can generate functional code and utilize toolboxes via MCP servers, but often fail to apply rigorous engineering practices like data validation splitting or overfit prevention by default.

Skill files are text-based markdown files that package engineering workflows, internal standards, and domain guidance into a format that agents automatically read and apply when relevant tasks are requested.
In a MATLAB system identification demonstration using OpenAI's Codex (GPT 5.4), an initial prompt generated a model using all available data, risking overfitting and omitting model stability checks.

After creating a skill file mandating estimation/validation data splits, residual whiteness checks, stability pole-zero mapping, and automated selection reports, subsequent prompts executed these constraints without requiring manual repetition.

Toolkits like the MATLAB and Simulink Agentic Toolkits provide MCP interfaces and base skill files, allowing organizations to layer custom engineering standards on top for consistent automated development.

items.title: The Unstoppable AI Discontinuity and Its Impact on Software, Labor, and Society
items.original_title: Stiamo per rompere col passato, per sempre
items.summary: AI development represents a massive technological discontinuity vastly exceeding the industrial revolution, driven by continuous scaling and reinforcement learning rather than a plateau. This shift is rendering traditional software development and knowledge work obsolete as non-technical users begin building custom tools through conversational interfaces, threatening widespread job displacement and posing severe psychological challenges for human society during the transition.
bullets: AI progress continues unabated through scaling laws and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, invalidating theories claiming LLMs have hit a plateau or require a physical body to achieve true intelligence.

Non-technical workers such as administrative staff and commercial roles are increasingly building their own custom software solutions by interacting directly with LLMs, bypassing traditional software development pipelines.
The traditional software engineering market is experiencing a contraction in turnover and hiring as companies fear human developers will soon become redundant.
Shifting human labor up the conceptual chain (from coding to strategic decision-making) fails because strategic roles require exceptional, rare talent and cannot absorb the mass of displaced workers.

While society may eventually adapt with new economic models or basic sustenance, the immediate transition will feature a dark phase of widespread unemployment, psychological distress, and societal disruption.
Cultural intellectuals and politicians are slowly beginning to address the social impacts of AI, though many still suffer from technical illiteracy regarding how LLMs function.

items.title: Analisi della tecnica N-gram nel modello Qwen 3.8 Flash Next
items.original_title: Gli n-gram di Qwen 3.8 Flash Next
items.summary: Il video analizza la tecnica degli n-gram (o n-grammi) utilizzata nel modello Qwen 3.8 Flash Next. Questa architettura sfrutta una tabella associativa statica di 51 miliardi di parametri per arricchire dinamicamente il significato degli ultimi token elaborati, riducendo il carico computazionale della rete neurale principale.
bullets: La tecnica utilizza una tabella associativa statica di 51 miliardi di parametri appresa durante il training per gestire concetti multi-parola complessi come 'New York' o 'storia dell'arte'.
Il sistema effettua un hashing dei token precedenti (ultimi due o tre token) nel primo layer, eseguendo il fetch dei dati in modo mascherato dalla latenza di elaborazione.
Nel secondo layer, una matrice confronta il vettore statico recuperato con lo stato interno del token, decidendo quanto arricchire il significato del token corrente.
I 51 miliardi di parametri associativi possono essere allocati nella RAM anziché nella VRAM ed essendo una tabella di lookup non richiedono pesanti moltiplicazioni matriciali.
La tecnica non aumenta la context window né la KV Cache e non va confusa con il speculative decoding.

items.title: La velocità della gravità e la sua misurazione attraverso la relatività generale
items.original_title: Cosa succederebbe se il Sole sparisse di colpo? La velocità della gravità
items.summary: Analisi storica e fisica della velocità della gravità, dalla gravità istantanea di Newton ai modelli di Laplace fino alla relatività generale di Einstein. Viene spiegato come la gravità si propaghi alla velocità della luce, confermato sperimentalmente nel 2017 dall'astronomia multimessaggero con la collisione di due stelle di neutroni.
bullets: Newton considerava la gravità una forza che agisce a distanza in modo istantaneo, pur ammettendo di non conoscerne la causa fisica (ipotesis non fingo).

All'inizio dell'Ottocento Laplace ipotizzò una velocità di propagazione finita della gravità tramite un flusso di particelle, calcolando che avrebbe causato l'instabilità delle orbite planetarie a meno di non essere milioni di volte superiore a quella della luce.

La relatività generale di Einstein descrive la gravità come curvatura dello spazio-tempo, in cui le masse si muovono rispetto alla posizione istantea dello spazio deformato, ma le variazioni di questa curvatura si propagano sotto forma di onde gravitazionali a velocità finita.

Il 17 agosto 2017 i rilevatori LIGO e Virgo hanno osservato la collisione di due stelle di neutroni a 140 milioni di anni luce, registrando sia onde gravitazionali che un lampo di luce arrivato 1,74 secondi dopo.
Il confronto tra la velocità della luce e quella delle onde gravitazionali ha confermato che coincidono con una precisione di una parte su un milione di miliardi (10^15).
Se il Sole sparisse improvvisamente, la Terra continuerebbe a risentire della sua attrazione gravitazionale e della sua luce per circa 8 minuti prima di accorgersene.

items.title: Jernej Barbič on Ziva VFX and Physics-Based Tissue Simulation
items.original_title: Oscar Winner Brings Monsters to Life With His Simulation Software
items.summary: Computer science professor Jernej Barbič developed Ziva VFX, a physics-based simulation tool that models internal muscle, fat, and skin mechanics for digital creatures in over 60 films. The software solves partial differential equations of nonlinear elasticity using finite element methods to achieve controllable, realistic soft-tissue dynamics. His recent research focuses on creating digital twins of human hands using MRI data to advance biomechanics, robotics, and medical prosthetics.
bullets: Ziva VFX uses finite element methods and numerical optimization to solve partial differential equations of nonlinear elasticity for musculoskeletal tissue.
The software simulates internal anatomical layers—including bones, muscles, fat, and skin—and their activation rather than just surface geometry.
Barbič co-founded Ziva Dynamics in 2015 to commercialize the technology, which was later acquired by Unity Technologies in 2021 and exclusively licensed to DNEG in 2024.
In NSF-funded research, Barbič created a digital twin of human hands by capturing MRI scans across 12 poses from four subjects to map bone and soft-tissue mechanics.
Prior to Ziva VFX, Barbič developed Vega FEM, an open-source library designed for animating 3D deformable objects.

items.title: Building the Scanwheel: A Portable 4K x 20 Mechanical TV
items.original_title: Make a Portable Wide-screen Mechanical TV
items.summary: The Scanwheel is a pocket-sized electromechanical display that uses a 6-centimeter 3D-printed Nipkow drum to achieve a 4,096 by 20 pixel widescreen resolution. By arranging five high-speed LED light sources inside the drum and driving them via a Raspberry Pi Pico, the device generates crisp, readable text and video streaming despite having only 20 vertical lines. The RP2040 microcontroller's Programmable Input/Output (PIO) hardware handles the timing-critical LED data readouts and motor step pulses independently of the main CPU cores.
bullets: Replaces traditional Nipkow disks with a 6-cm 3D-printed Nipkow drum featuring stair-stepped pinholes to maintain horizontal alignment without image curvature distortion.
Achieves a 4,096 x 20 resolution (with tests exceeding 8,000 horizontal pixels) by rapidly modulating five internal LEDs across multiple display segments.
Utilizes the Raspberry Pi Pico's RP2040 PIO coprocessors to directly drive motor step pulses and stream frame buffer data to single-color and RGB LEDs simultaneously.
Streams video data into the board's frame buffer over a network interface to support live video playback and PC display mirroring.
Provides open-source OpenSCAD scripts on GitHub to allow customization of drum dimensions and scan line counts.

Virtual Power Plants enable energy companies to remotely throttle consumer devices like smart thermostats, EV chargers, and home batteries during peak demand hours in exchange for bill discounts.

items.title: How to sign up for a virtual power plant—and decide whether you should
items.original_title: How to sign up for a virtual power plant—and decide whether you should
items.summary: Virtual power plants (VPPs) network household devices like smart thermostats, EV chargers, and batteries to adjust energy demand during peak hours in exchange for consumer incentives. Thermostat programs typically yield $25–$50 annually, while EV and home battery setups can generate hundreds to thousands of dollars in savings. Deciding to join requires evaluating device compatibility, personal routine flexibility, opt-out rules, and data privacy implications.
bullets: VPP scale and adoption: Over 500 VPP programs were active in the US by 2023, enrolling 4 million smart thermostat households, with tech companies like Google investing in VPPs for data center power.
Financial rewards: Smart thermostats offer $50–$150 initial bonuses plus $25–$50 per year, whereas home battery and EV charging management can yield hundreds to thousands in annual returns.
Enrollment pathways: Programs are found via utility demand response search terms or directly through device manufacturer apps for EVs, batteries, and smart thermostats.
Lifestyle and privacy trade-offs: Device control can disrupt specific routines (e.g., shift work or caregiving), and operational data shared with third parties may reveal home behavior patterns.
Grid impact and risks: Poorly targeted VPPs risk subsidizing unused power and raising bills for non-participants, but properly managed programs help utilities defer costly infrastructure upgrades.

items.title: Generation Lab's Generic Drug Combo Aims to Mimic Blood Plasma Rejuvenation
items.original_title: A startup claims it’s found a drug to make your blood young
items.summary: Generation Lab, co-founded by former UC Berkeley researcher Irina Conboy, is promoting a two-drug combination called 1 Generation designed to replicate the anti-aging benefits of therapeutic plasma exchange. The treatment uses two undisclosed generic drugs selected via a microfluidic screening system that exposes human cells to aged blood serum. The startup plans a 100-plus person clinical trial managed by longevity physicians to pursue short-term FDA exclusivity for the combination use.
bullets: Irina Conboy's foundational research showed that replacing aged plasma with an albumin and saline solution removes systemic aging factors and rejuvenates tissue regenerative capacity.
1 Generation combines two off-patent generic drugs intended to stimulate cellular regeneration while neutralizing harmful factors present in old blood serum.
Candidate molecules were screened using a microfluidic testing device that exposes human cell cultures directly to elderly blood serum to measure protective effects.
Because the underlying molecules are generic, Generation Lab aims to secure up to three years of FDA market exclusivity by proving a novel combination use through clinical trials.
The upcoming 100-patient trial will be free to participants and overseen by alternative longevity practitioners, following informal trial runs among company insiders.

items.title: 12TB Steam Data Leak Exposes Legacy Steam2 Server Files (2003–2013)
items.original_title: A 12TB Steam “teraleak” spills more than a decade of lost PC gaming history
items.summary: A massive 12TB data dump of Valve's defunct Steam2 server architecture has leaked online via BitTorrent, covering the platform's history from 2003 to 2013. The archive contains thousands of game depots including public release builds as well as previously unreleased pre-release, prototype, and playtest versions. The dataset cuts off in 2013, coinciding with Valve's architecture migration from Steam2 to the modern SteamPipe distribution system.
bullets: The BitTorrent leak comprises over 12TB of content from Steam's legacy Steam2 servers between 2003 and 2013.
Files include thousands of game depots featuring public builds, pre-release versions, prototypes, and playtests from Valve and third-party developers.
The leak ends in 2013 because Valve retired the proprietary Steam2 system in favor of its HTTP-based SteamPipe distribution architecture.
SteamPipe replaced Steam2 to eliminate Valve update approval bottlenecks and enable differential file patch downloads.

bullets: Meta is trialing robots from Watney Robotics, Kinova, and ABB to perform physical data center maintenance.
The company is evaluating the Kinova Gen3 robotic arm to control server power cycling and electricity cutoffs.
A dedicated cable-swapping robot is being tested with the potential to automate up to 80% of certain physical tasks.
The initiative is designed to trim human headcount requirements and control labor costs as Meta scales its AI infrastructure.

items.title: Corporate Compliance Failures in Processing CCPA Data Access Requests
items.original_title: I asked 100 companies for my data. Some deleted it instead.
items.summary: A consumer privacy investigation involving over 100 California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) data access requests revealed widespread corporate compliance failures. While McDonald's fulfilled a request with a 515-page behavioral analysis report, multiple other companies erroneously deleted user data or rejected standard submission channels. Advocates highlight these execution failures as evidence of weak regulatory frameworks reliant on voluntary corporate compliance.
bullets: Under the CCPA, covered businesses must fulfill data access requests within 45 days through at least two listed contact methods.
McDonald's fulfilled an access request with a 515-page report detailing granular app interactions and predictive retention modeling.
Several companies mistakenly deleted user data instead of providing access copies, violating explicit consumer instructions.
Multiple organizations refused to honor access requests submitted through the official channels specified in their own privacy policies.
Ben Winters of the Consumer Federation of America noted that these issues reflect the weakness of relying on corporate good faith for privacy compliance.

items.title: Court Rules Kalshi Sports Bets Subject to Nevada Gambling Laws

bullets: The 9th Circuit Court of Appeals unanimously affirmed a district court order allowing Nevada to enforce state gaming laws against Kalshi.
The ruling rejects claims that the federal Commodity Exchange Act preempts state law for sports contracts offered by Kalshi, Crypto.com, and Robinhood.
Nevada Governor Joe Lombardo stated that prediction markets offering sports-event contracts constitute gambling and must comply with state frameworks.

items.title: Il modello Human-AI Teaming nella docenza aumentata
items.original_title: Il modello Human-AI Teaming: scenari futuri della docenza aumentata (Aluisi Tosolini)
items.summary: Il modello Human-AI Teaming ridefinisce il rapporto tra docenti e intelligenza artificiale come un ecosistema cognitivo ibrido e co-evolutivo. In questo scenario, il docente evolve da trasmettitore di contenuti a curatore e regista dei processi formativi, mantenendo la responsabilità pedagogica e il giudizio critico.
bullets: Il modello Human-AI Teaming supera la contrapposizione o la delega totale all'IA, proponendo una collaborazione strutturata dove specifici compiti operativi sono affidati alla macchina mentre l'umano mantiene il presidio pedagogico.
Il paradosso della performance evidenzia il rischio che un'assistenza IA troppo forte indebolisca le risorse cognitive umane se la cooperazione non è progettata con cura.
Il ruolo del docente si trasforma nel principio dello Human-as-Curator: interpretare, orientare, selezionare, validare e contestualizzare gli output dell'intelligenza artificiale.
La relazione educativa e la cura della persona rimangono atti profondamente umani e insostituibili da parte di sistemi artificiali.
La docenza aumentata riduce il tempo dedicato a esecuzioni ripetitive per focalizzarsi su progettazione, verifica, governance etica e regia dei processi di apprendimento.
L'uso del diario di bordo viene suggerito come strumento pratico per documentare la sperimentazione e sviluppare la consapevolezza professionale riflessiva.

bullets: Custom AI assistants must be configured for specific purposes, audiences, and tasks rather than used as generalist chatbots.
Designing an assistant involves setting explicit instructions regarding scope, tone, boundaries, roles, and source materials.
The AI-mentored model uses scaffolding, calibrated feedback, and progressive steps to guide learners while maintaining student agency.
Human-AI teaming ensures repetitive or exploratory tasks are delegated to the AI while humans retain control over judgment, meaning, and responsibility.
The 'Human-as-Curator' principle positions educators to select, validate, and contextualize AI outputs to ensure quality and coherence.

items.title: Cosa succederebbe alla Terra se il Sole sparisse?
items.original_title: La Terra senza il Sole
items.summary: An analysis of the physical and environmental consequences if the Sun were to disappear or the Earth were ejected from the solar system, based on scientific simulations from a 2000 study titled 'Frozen Earth'. It explores orbital mechanics, the collapse of photosynthesis, internal planetary heat, and the long-term freezing of oceans.
bullets: If the Sun disappeared, the Earth would notice after approximately 8 minutes and 20 seconds regarding both light and gravity, drifting along a tangent at an orbital speed of about 100,000 km/h.

A 2000 scientific study estimated a 1 in 50,000 probability that Earth's orbit will be drastically altered by passing stars over the next 3.5 billion years, and a 1 in 400,000 chance of complete ejection from the solar system.
Without sunlight, photosynthetic activity would cease within days, collapsing the global food chain and biosphere almost immediately.

Earth's internal heat sources—including primordial heat and radioactive decay of uranium, thorium, and potassium in the mantle—would sustain surface temperatures at absolute zero equilibrium of around -239°C within a decade.

While surface water and the top ocean layers would freeze within a month, complete freezing of Earth's oceans would take approximately half a million years due to ice insulation and internal heat, leaving only localized hydrothermal vent ecosystems.

Planets with oceans deeper than 15 km or those receiving minimal stellar warmth could theoretically maintain subsurface liquid water oceans driven by internal radioactivity, suggesting subsurface habitability could be common in the universe.

items.title: Mastodon's Marrow Deep
items.original_title: Marrow Deep

bullets: Brent Hinds was fired from Mastodon in March 2025 and died in an Atlanta motorcycle crash on August 20, 2025.

items.summary: Serie A clubs heavily rely on loans and options to buy to manage finances and defer costs, contrasting sharply with leagues like the Premier League. Data from Transfermarkt shows massive numbers of both incoming and outgoing loans, driven by economic constraints, lack of second teams, and a cultural preference for player development via loans rather than immediate first-team exposure.
bullets: Transfermarkt data shows Serie A recorded 77 total loans (incoming/with option or obligation) last season, of which 49 returned to their parent clubs, compared to only 31 for Chelsea in the Premier League.
Out of 77 incoming loans last season, only 28 turned into permanent transfers, exemplified by Roma choosing not to exercise Evan Ferguson's 38 million euro option.
Serie A is the leading league for outgoing loans with 349 players loaned out in the 2025/26 season, dwarfing the Premier League's 180.
Clubs with U23 second teams (Atalanta, Inter, Juventus, Milan) cap their outgoing loans at a more humane maximum of 12.
Historical context shows a decline from 526 outgoing loans a decade ago, but incoming loans grew from 47 in 2000/01 to a peak of 150 in 2015/16 and 112 last season.

items.title: A Reimagined Bimodal Nuclear Engine for Mars Missions
items.original_title: Noodling on Nuclear Engines
items.summary: NASA's Kurt Polzin and General Atomics' Robert Schleicher have proposed a synchronal bimodal nuclear engine concept designed to halve transit times to Mars. The hybrid system combines nuclear thermal propulsion with nuclear electric propulsion to minimize astronaut exposure to severe cosmic radiation and microgravity outside the Van Allen belts. Although electric propulsion is relatively mature, integrating it with nuclear thermal systems remains at the conceptual paper-planning stage.
bullets: Proposes a synchronal bimodal nuclear engine combining nuclear thermal propulsion and nuclear electric propulsion.
Designed to halve the travel time to Mars, mitigating severe health risks from cosmic radiation outside the Van Allen belts and prolonged microgravity.

items.title: The Origin of the Voltaic Pile and the Galvani-Volta Debate
items.original_title: The First Battery Was Inspired By a Dead Frog
items.summary: Alessandro Volta invented the first battery—the voltaic pile—in 1799 as a direct counter-argument to Luigi Galvani's theory of animal electricity. While Volta proved that electricity could be generated via dissimilar metals and wet separators, both scientists contributed to distinct fields: electrochemistry and electrophysiology.
bullets: In 1791, Luigi Galvani published findings on frog muscle contractions, claiming they resulted from an innate 'animal electricity' stored in the nerves and muscles.
Alessandro Volta contested Galvani's conclusions, arguing that the electrical charge originated from the contact of two different metals rather than the animal tissue.
To prove his theory, Volta built the voltaic pile in 1799, stacking alternating copper and zinc discs separated by brine- or acid-soaked blotting paper to generate a sustained low-current output.
Shortly after Volta announced his invention, scientists William Nicholson and Anthony Carlisle used it to discover chemical electrolysis by splitting water into hydrogen and oxygen.
Galvani's nephew, Giovanni Aldini, used voltaic piles for public demonstrations on animal and human remains, which notably inspired Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein.
Historically framed as a simple contest with Volta as the winner, the debate actually founded two separate disciplines: electrochemistry for Volta and electrophysiology for Galvani.

bullets: Development started in 2024 using starter kits with microcontrollers, cables, and sensors assembled on a breadboard.

bullets: David Fair co-founded Half Japanese with his brother Jad in the mid-1970s, pioneering a radical DIY art-punk sound.

items.original_title: Cosa può insegnarci un terremoto
items.summary: Following the devastating 6.5 magnitude earthquake in Friuli on May 6, 1976, local communities organized spontaneous bottom-up committees based on pre-existing social bonds. Rather than acting as passive recipients of aid, residents managed relief efforts directly, demonstrating that community-led reconstruction strategies foster resilience, political agency, and public participation that can serve as a model for addressing future climate disasters.
bullets: On May 6, 1976, a 6.5 magnitude earthquake struck northern Friuli-Venezia Giulia, resulting in 990 deaths and nearly 100,000 displaced persons.
In the hamlet of Godo (Gemona), residents formed autonomous committees to distribute aid, leveraging deep neighborhood familiarity to prevent waste, duplication, and social stigma.

On May 25, 1976, an assembly of 340 Gemonesi (85 percent of eligible voters) democratically elected a nine-person committee by a show of hands, using a mandatory recall system to keep delegates accountable to the general assembly.

Unlike typical emergency groups that dissolve quickly, Friulian committees published an independent newsletter ('Bollettino di coordinamento delle tendopoli') and actively challenged municipal authorities and political parties to advocate for working-class interests and local cooperative rebuilding.

Research by Daniel Aldrich, John Twigg, Irina Mosel, and Lynne Keevers confirms that grassroots, community-led disaster recovery improves outcomes by building trust, agency, and tailored local solutions.

items.summary: Director Zeina Daccache's 2012 theatrical and therapeutic project at Baabda women's prison in Lebanon used the myth of Scheherazade to help inmates process trauma, domestic abuse, and the flaws of the legal system. The resulting play and documentary, Scheherazade's Diary, challenged bourgeois theatrical norms, highlighted institutional failures, and contributed to the historical passage of Lebanon's domestic violence law in 2014.
bullets: In 2012, director Zeina Daccache led a 10-month artistic and therapeutic program at Baabda women's prison near Beirut, culminating in the play Scheherazade a Baabda and the documentary Scheherazade's Diary.
The project involved 15 inmates, many of whom were imprisoned for crimes related to domestic violence, systemic abuse, or awaiting trial in overcrowded conditions without medical care.
The performance inverted traditional staging by placing the audience—composed of family members, journalists, and the inmates' own judges—at the center, turning the prisoners into dominant observers.
The theatrical work and subsequent public tour catalyzed a political breakthrough: the Lebanese Parliament approved a law protecting women and families from domestic violence in April 2014.

The text argues against treating prison theater as a mere recreational luxury, framing it instead as a systemic therapeutic and political tool necessary to counteract disculturation and institutional collapse, contrasting it with issues in Italian prisons.

items.title: Using Heart Rate Variability (HRV) to Optimize Running Training and Recovery
items.original_title: My HRV Was Concerningly Low. Improving It Helped Me Have My Best Training Block to Date.
items.summary: Heart rate variability (HRV) serves as a key physiological tracker for balancing stress and recovery during athletic training. By identifying a chronically low baseline caused by overtraining, poor sleep, and stress, a runner can implement targeted lifestyle adjustments to improve recovery metrics and achieve better performance.
bullets: HRV measures the time interval between consecutive heartbeats, reflecting autonomic nervous system stress and recovery, with a normal healthy adult range typically between 19 and 75 milliseconds.
Genetics account for 50 to 60 percent of baseline HRV differences between individuals, while the remaining variance is driven by lifestyle factors like sleep, nutrition, hydration, and training load.
Wearables like Garmin capture HRV data during 5-minute windows at night and require a 3-week calibration period to establish a personal baseline before tracking 7-day rolling averages.
Experts recommend establishing your baseline during low-stress base training or postrace recovery periods rather than during intense training blocks.
Sustained downward trends in HRV lasting one to two weeks typically signal overtraining, inadequate sleep, dehydration, or illness, rather than isolated daily fluctuations.

Actionable recovery protocols include aiming for 7 to 9 hours of sleep nightly—adding approximately one minute of sleep for every mile run per week—and maintaining proper hydration to prevent increased heart strain.

items.title: Come sono, suona by Susan Rogers and Ogi Ogas
items.original_title: Come sono, suona di Susan Rogers e Ogi Ogas
items.summary: In 'Come sono, suona', audio engineer Susan Rogers and neuroscientist Ogi Ogas examine the variables that shape musical perception and personal taste. While the book succeeds in categorizing auditory elements like timbre and authenticity, it falls short of fully explaining the neuroscientific evolution of personal taste.
bullets: The book categorizes our auditory profile into seven specific variables: genuineness, realism, originality, melody, lyrics, rhythm, and timbre.
Timbre is identified as the primary filter for creating an initial connection with a song, distinguishing the unique voice of instruments or producers like Aaron Dessner and Steve Albini.
Aesthetical pleasure is linked to 'mind-wandering' and the default mode network, which activates when attention turns inward and connects sound to our sense of identity.
Listeners gravitate toward sad songs not to become sad, but to feel less lonely through empathy and connection with the artist or a past version of themselves.
The authors utilize a curated playlist and guest testimonials to demonstrate how different individuals project their lived experiences and genetics onto the same music.

bullets: La palude di Shrek rappresenta un sistema di difesa per evitare il giudizio altrui legato alla sua natura di orco.
Fiona vive la condizione opposta ma complementare: è stata educata a rispettare rigidi standard estetici e comportamentali per essere scelta.
L'amore tra i due non nasce da semplici affinità, ma dalla condivisione di un'esperienza di liberazione dalle aspettative del mondo.
Il legame autentico non si fonda su una rassicurazione costante o sull'approvazione incondizionata dei difetti.
La relazione offre la possibilità di sperimentare il riconoscimento profondo anziché la mera accettazione superficiale.

bullets: Il regista utilizza i temi dell'Odissea come filo conduttore che unisce i suoi film precedenti, da Memento a Interstellar e Oppenheimer.
Personaggi come Leonard Shelby, Cooper, Dom Cobb e Oppenheimer riflettono diverse sfaccettature del poema, tra perdita di memoria, legami familiari, erranza nei sogni e colpa per le armi distruttive.
Il poema omerico viene manipolato e rielaborato per dimostrare la potenza narrativa delle storie e l'urgenza di preservare la memoria collettiva.
